rules.title: No-fault eviction: Declaration of Intent to Evict and notice filing (RSO/JCO)
rules.requirement: Before a landlord evicts for a not-at-fault reason from an RSO or JCO unit, the landlord must pay relocation assistance and file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD. The termination notice may be served only after the declaration is filed, and a copy of the notice must be filed with LAHD within 3 days of service.
rules.coverage_text: Units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) or the Just Cause Ordinance (JCO).
rules.quoted_span: Failure to file the Landlord Declaration with the LAHD makes the eviction a violation of the RSO or JCO.
rules.key_value: Copy of notice filed with LAHD no later than 3 days after service
rules.penalty: Eviction without the filing is a violation of the RSO or JCO
rules.ambiguity_note: Bulletin B says the notice copy must be filed within 3 business days, while Bulletin A says 3 days.

rules.title: Permitted not-at-fault reasons for eviction under RSO/JCO
rules.requirement: Not-at-fault evictions are permitted only for listed reasons: owner/family/resident manager occupancy, demolition, conversion or removal from rental use, a government order to vacate, HUD pre-sale vacancy, residential hotel unit conversion or demolition, and conversion to affordable housing. Each requires relocation assistance.
rules.coverage_text: Units covered by the RSO or JCO; items 7 (demolition/conversion) applies regardless of RSO/JCO coverage.
rules.exemptions_text: Resident manager occupancy evictions allowed only if required by law, an affordable housing covenant, or a regulatory agreement.
rules.quoted_span:
The landlord seeks in good faith to recover possession of the rental unit to demolish, convert 
to a commercial use, or remove it from rental housing use (LAMC 151.09.A.10, 165.03.I).

rules.title: Relocation assistance amounts and timing for no-fault evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay relocation assistance per unit for no-fault evictions, with amounts depending on eligible/qualified tenant status, length of tenancy and income (for July 1, 2026–June 30, 2027: eligible $11,000/$14,400; qualified $23,150/$27,400). Payment must be made available within 15 days of service of the written eviction notice; the amount increases every July 1.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in RSO or JCO units displaced for a no-fault reason.

exemption_tests.description: Evicting a resident manager to replace with another resident manager (Manager-Tenants may still be entitled).
Eviction required due to hazardous conditions from a natural disaster not caused by landlord negligence.

rules.exemptions_text: Exempt: resident manager replacement; hazardous conditions from natural disaster not caused by landlord's negligence.
rules.quoted_span: Payment shall be made available within fifteen (15) days of service of the written notice of eviction; however,
rules.penalty: Failure to pay is an affirmative defense for the tenant in an eviction action; tenant may file complaint with LAHD

rules.title: Reduced relocation for Mom and Pop owner/family occupancy evictions
rules.requirement: Small landlords may pay reduced relocation ($10,550 eligible; $21,250 qualified in 2026-27) for good-faith owner or eligible relative occupancy evictions if all four conditions are met.
rules.coverage_text: Buildings with four or fewer rental units; landlord owns no more than four units plus a single-family home on a separate lot in LA; not used in previous three years.

rules.title: Resident Protections Ordinance: relocation for demolition for new construction
rules.requirement: Owners demolishing Protected Units for new construction must pay the highest applicable relocation amounts under State and City law, enhanced for lower income households (Chart B standardized payments $115,480 / $96,750 / $87,450 in 2026-27), and provide occupant protections including right to remain up to 6 months and right to return. Owners choose one of three relocation options.
rules.coverage_text: Protected Units (including all RSO units) to be demolished for new construction.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Resident Protections Ordinance, Ordinances #188481 and #188482; Cal. Gov. Code § 66300 et seq.
rules.quoted_span: Failure to comply with the RPO may result in financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit and withholding of LAHD permit clearances.
rules.key_value: $115,480 extremely low; $96,750 very low; $87,450 low income
rules.penalty: Financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit; withholding of LAHD permit clearances
